title: The Fool Says There Is No God

questions.question: The fool says in his heart, "There is no what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:1 (ESV): "The fool says in his heart, 'There is no God.'"

questions.question: They are corrupt, doing abominable iniquity; there is none who does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:1 (ESV): "...there is none who does good."

questions.question: God looks down from heaven on the children of man to see if there are any who understand, who seek after whom?
They have all fallen away; together they have become what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:3 (ESV): "They have all fallen away; together they have become corrupt;"

questions.question: There is none who does good, not even how many?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:3 (ESV): "there is none who does good, not even one."

questions.question: Have those who work evil no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:4 (ESV): "...who eat up my people as they eat bread,"

questions.question: And do not call upon whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:4 (ESV): "...and do not call upon God?"

questions.question: There they are, in great terror, where there is no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:5 (ESV): "There they are, in great terror, where there is no terror!"

questions.question: For God scatters the bones of him who encamps against whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:5 (ESV): "For God scatters the bones of him who encamps against you;"

questions.question: You put them to shame, for God has done what to them?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:5 (ESV): "you put them to shame, for God has rejected them."

questions.question: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:6 (ESV): "Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion!"

questions.question: When God restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be what?
This Psalm is very similar to which other Psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53 is almost identical to Psalm 14, with some variation in the name of God (Elohim vs Yahweh).

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 53?
Who says there is no God?
questions.explanation: Psalm 53:1 (ESV): "The fool says in his heart, 'There is no God.'"

key_verse_text: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, doing abominable iniquity; there is none who does good.
